title: Bug: run_shell_command fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading \'publish\')'

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear and actionable bug report describing an internal tool error ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'publish')') when attempting to execute git checkout or git branch commands using run_shell_command.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires adding optional chaining and null/undefined checks for messageBus and getMessageBus() across both core (BaseToolInvocation) and cli packages (ToolActionsContext, useGeminiStream).

summary.problem: Executing git checkout or git branch commands via run_shell_command fails with an unhandled TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'publish').
summary.root_cause: BaseToolInvocation.publishPolicyUpdate and CLI context handlers attempt to invoke publish() directly on messageBus or config.getMessageBus() without optional chaining or validating that messageBus is defined.
summary.context: When running tools in environments or scenarios where messageBus is undefined or optional, triggering a policy update or confirmation response attempts to call .publish() on an undefined object, causing tool execution to crash.

steps: In packages/core/src/tools/tools.ts, update BaseToolInvocation.publishPolicyUpdate to use optional chaining when calling this.messageBus?.publish(...).
In packages/cli/src/ui/contexts/ToolActionsContext.tsx, update config.getMessageBus().publish calls to use optional chaining config.getMessageBus()?.publish(...).
In packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/useGeminiStream.ts, update config.getMessageBus().publish calls to use optional chaining config.getMessageBus()?.publish(...).

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Shell commands and tool invocations handle policy updates gracefully without throwing a TypeError when messageBus is undefined.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/core/src/tools/shell.test.ts and packages/core/src/tools/base-tool-invocation.test.ts verifying that executing tool invocations with an undefined messageBus does not throw an error when publishPolicyUpdate is called.
